body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary -1 penalty to the target's next Success Die until the start of your next turn; it becomes Rallied for that duration.

surges.html: The target gains +1 Composure against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.
An additional willing creature within 2 units receives the numerical suppression.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when the target misses a Combat Card: it may move 1 unit after resolving. This does not grant another attempt.
